name: Tenshi Kourin
source:
300 years have passed. Main character is a court priest in a certain kingdom.  An alchemist predicts that kingdom can be driven out of crisis with the help of homunculus. Protagonist happens to be the person of choice to teach the homunculus human emotions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
